description: Defines the SimpleDecodingSource class, which provides an interface for media decoding using MediaCodec, including creation, control, and reading methods, along with internal state management.

classes.name: SimpleDecodingSource
classes.description: A media source class that uses MediaCodec for decoding, supporting creation with various options, starting, stopping, retrieving format, and reading media buffers.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a SimpleDecodingSource with specified source, flags, native window, desired codec, and option to skip MediaCodec list.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the media source, initializing underlying components.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the media source and its underlying components.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the output format of the media source.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads media data into a buffer, blocking until data is available.
